title: Tru Tien Episode 13: The Man Who Lost His Wife's Name
audience: Fans of Chinese fantasy, wuxia/xianxia drama viewers, 18-35 demographic who enjoy epic visual storytelling
tone: Heroic, melancholic, epic, cinematic, emotionally charged

concept.hook: She healed a soldier's wound and watched his pain disappear — then discovered he had been the one to KILL his own wife in the war. The curse does not erase guilt. It amplifies it.
concept.story_arc: Soldier healed → Memory released → Crime revealed → Pain multiplies → Curse malfunction
concept.emotion: Mercy → Shock → Horror → Rage → Curse failure

shots.prompt: Medium shot — she finds a wounded soldier collapsed on a battlefield road. His uniform is torn, his side bleeding from a spear wound. She kneels and places her hand over his wound. She SPEAKS the curse. The wound closes — his face relaxes. He looks up at her with relief. Camera: medium, her kneeling, hand on wound, curse speaking, relief on soldier's face. 6 seconds.
shots.camera: Two-shot — her kneeling, curse speaking, soldier's wound closing, relief on his face, 6s
shots.narration: She had healed so many by now that it felt almost routine. Hand on wound. Speak the curse. Watch the pain disappear. Except — this time — something went wrong.
shots.sfx: Spear wound closing with flesh sound, her curse speaking, soldier's relief exhale, wind on battlefield

shots.prompt: Close-up — the soldier's face changes. The relief melts into HORROR. He SCREAMS — not in pain, but in grief. His hands claw at his face. 'HER FACE,' he screams. 'HER FACE.' He is seeing his wife's face. The curse did not just heal his wound — it RELEASED his memory. Camera: extreme close-up on soldier's screaming face, memory appearing in his eyes. 6 seconds.
shots.camera: Extreme close-up — soldier's face morphing from relief to horror, clawing his face, 'Her face' scream, released memory, 6s
shots.narration: The curse had not just healed his wound. It had released the memory it was attached to. And in that memory — he saw her face. His wife. The woman he had killed.
shots.sfx: Scream, flesh tearing sound, memory whoosh, his wife's name scream, horror bass

shots.prompt: Medium — she tries to grab his hands to heal him again. But the curse doesn't work on THIS kind of pain. 'I killed her,' he says calmly now, smiling. 'The curse gave me back my memory — and with it, the pain of what I did. I feel it TEN TIMES.' His smile is terrifying. She steps back. Camera: medium two-shot, his terrifying calm smile, her step back in horror, released guilt. 6 seconds.
shots.camera: Two-shot — soldier's terrifying calm smile, 'I killed her', her step back in horror, guilt amplified tenfold, 6s
shots.narration: I killed her. The curse had given him back his memory — and with it, the full weight of his guilt. Ten times amplified. His wife had been in the war zone. He had killed her himself.
shots.sfx: His calm speech, her sharp inhale, distant battlefield wind, horror strings building, revelation sting

shots.prompt: Wide shot — the soldier walks calmly into the burning palace ruins. He turns back and says: 'The curse did not save me, witch. It damned me twice.' He walks into the flames. She tries to run after him — the grimoire RIPS a page. The curse is rejecting him. He is beyond saving. Camera: wide, burning palace, soldier walking into flames, grimoire page ripping, her reaching. 6 seconds.
shots.camera: Wide — soldier walking into burning palace, 'damned me twice', grimoire page ripping, her reaching, unable to save, 6s
shots.narration: The curse had not just failed him. It had made his guilt worse — and in doing so, had damned him twice over. Some pain could not be transferred. Some crimes could not be undone.
shots.sfx: Flames roaring, grimoire page ripping, his footsteps in fire, her scream, tragic orchestral swell

shots.prompt: Close-up — she stands before the burning palace, grimoire in hand, the ripped page dissolving to ash in the wind. Her hands shake. She reads the curse's true nature now: it could heal WAR WOUNDS. But it could not heal the wounds of what war MADE people do. She looks at her blood-stained hands. Camera: close-up, blood-stained hands holding dissolving page, burning palace reflection, understanding horror. 6 seconds.
shots.camera: Close-up — blood-stained hands with dissolving ash page, burning palace reflection, understanding dawning, 6s
shots.narration: The curse could heal the wounds of war. But the war had made people into monsters. And those monsters — the curse could not save. It could only remind them of what they had done.
shots.sfx: Page dissolving, ash falling, her shaking breath, wind, dark revelation, somber strings

audio.narration: She had healed so many by now that it felt almost routine. Hand on wound. Speak the curse. Watch the pain disappear. Except — this time — something went wrong. The curse had not just healed his wound. It had released the memory it was attached to. And in that memory — he saw her face. His wife. The woman he had killed. I killed her. The curse had given him back his memory — and with it, the full weight of his guilt. Ten times amplified. His wife had been in the war zone. He had killed her himself. The curse had not just failed him. It had made his guilt worse — and in doing so, had damned him twice over. Some pain could not be transferred. Some crimes could not be undone. The curse could heal the wounds of war. But the war had made people into monsters. And those monsters — the curse could not save. It could only remind them of what they had done.
audio.bg_music: Dark tragic Chinese orchestral, guilt amplification theme, crime revelation, curse failure, war horror 70 BPM

sfx.sound: Spear wound closing with flesh sound
